name: value-v2-100k-aug-a

gate.primary: pooled AUC of the network on the 5,000 test games' end-of-turn rows minus the better of the served leaf and shared score; game-clustered bootstrap 95% LCB > 0

note: Predeclared 2026-11-05 before training, after value-v2-100k (plain MLP, Adam) overfit from epoch 0 (val loss .483 -> .707) and matched but did not beat the 40-feature model (AUC .746). Same re-encoded shards (runs/value-v2-100k-shards; identical data keys) and the same test split, gate and predeclared pv2b within-decision cross-eval. Changes: AlphaGo-style board-symmetry augmentation (a random one of the 12 hex symmetries per row per batch; standardization symmetrized over the orbit), AdamW with decoupled weight decay, cosine learning-rate decay with 3% warmup. Arm A isolates augmentation + optimizer on the same small MLP (1324-256-256-1).
cross_eval_predeclared: Once runs/pv2-data-v1 exists, this model is also scored with the pv2 within-decision gate on the pv2 test decisions (picked candidate's 24-playout win rate minus the served candidate's, game-clustered LCB). That answers whether 100k on-policy outcome data with encoder v2 orders a decision's options; it is reported alongside pv2-train and is not a substitute for it.
